'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Kingery DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
